intro.title: Marble Idols
intro.descriptionHtml: Premium collection of Gods and Goddesses Idols made of high quality Marble. Each Deity idol in the collection is crafted to perfection and is a fine example of amazing craftsmanship. Worshipped for blessings of respective Deities, these marble idols are ideal to be placed on the Puja altar. The marble idols are also apt for gifting to your dear ones on special events and occasions.
